name: `shoptet init` command
description:
Scaffolder: addon vs theme, one target generation (g3/g4) + one target template number, extend/clean mode, development-shop URL. Writes the committed shoptet.config.json (identity, generation, template, dev-shop, mode, createdWith) and shoptet.lock (resolved knowledge-bundle digest), creates gitignored .shoptet/, and appends the .gitignore entry (never overwrites an existing one).

Drops only editor-agnostic configs: thin .stylelintrc / flat eslint.config.js extending the shared packages, plus .editorconfig — no .vscode/, no .idea/. Pins @shoptet/datalayer and generates shoptet-env.d.ts.

Every prompt needs a non-interactive flag equivalent (--name, --generation, --template, --dev-shop, --slots, --mode, --yes) per the agent-ready contract in §9.

Reference: cli-greenfield.md §5.7, §9, §10.
